quote_provenance_note: All four speech excerpts are from EX-S03, a non-government transcript; combined quoted words = 18. No independent audio verification claimed.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Oval Office announcement by Trump and Vance.
Promised an uncapped one-percent commission.
statements.evidence_limits: Non-government transcription; no corresponding unlimited written WHIP formula located.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Described the percentage as contingent on recovered money.
statements.evidence_limits: Does not establish a percentage of projected savings.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Required claimant provenance and acknowledged legal/rule qualifications.
Proposed personally resolving reward disputes and prompt payment.
statements.evidence_limits: Written WHIP assigns decisions to DOJ, not a presidential arbitration process.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Described reward scope extending beyond criminal prosecutions.
statements.short_exact_quote: not to limit this just to criminal prosecutions
statements.evidence_limits: Written WHIP expressly requires criminal charges.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Asserted that over 99% of fraud being found falls outside the False Claims Act.
statements.evidence_limits: Attributed assertion only; no methodology, denominator or statutory coverage analysis supplied here.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Described proposed mandatory minimums and state-official civil liability.
statements.evidence_limits: Speech is not proof of congressional passage; legislative verification delegated to congressional report.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Launch announcement identifies Treasury commitment of $25 million.
statements.evidence_limits: Not proof of disbursement or individual eligibility.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Three-year pilot invokes 28 U.S.C. §530C(b)(1)(L); rewards remain discretionary.
statements.evidence_limits: Cited statutory authority needs independent statutory analysis; see congressional report.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: $10,000–$30,000 per distinct tip, generally following unsealed charges; no conviction or recovery prerequisite.
statements.evidence_limits: Eligibility is not a payment guarantee; detailed terms allow discretionary pre-unsealing payment.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: DOJ decides awards; the guidance describes determinations as non-appealable and non-reviewable.
Eligibility requires voluntary, truthful, complete written original information, cooperation and criminal charges.
Covered areas include health-care offenses and listed agencies’ programs/benefits; priorities include hospice, home health, day care and special services.
statements.evidence_limits: Does not establish coverage of every government procurement transaction.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Terms introduction omits Department of War, while eligibility§6 includes it.
statements.evidence_limits: Launch release, FAQ and current landing page also include War; obtain clarification for defense-specific award assumptions.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Independent analysis may combine public information and collaborators, but must reveal non-general information and materially add to government knowledge.
statements.evidence_limits: Public-data analysis is not automatically original; government knowledge cannot be inferred solely from public searches.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Repetition of news or proceedings generally fails originality; identical subsequent tips fail. Only individuals qualify.
No minimum loss is required; unsuccessful schemes can qualify if charges follow.
Portal is preferred; alternate-channel submissions may be rejected. Anonymous tips require counsel; confidentiality has exceptions.
statements.evidence_limits: No submission was made in this research.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Directive prioritizes procurement/contract fraud and orders whistleblower-policy development while cautioning against overbroad enforcement.
statements.evidence_limits: Enforcement jurisdiction is broader than WHIP award eligibility.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Order creates task force, promotes preventative controls and private False Claims Act actions.
statements.evidence_limits: No universal 1% reward mechanism identified in the order.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: Dashboard distinguishes identified amounts, annualized prevention and enforcement metrics.
statements.evidence_limits: Enforcement descriptions include indictments and settlements; not a reconciled collected-cash reward base.

statements.claim_or_paraphrase: No blanket U.S. citizenship or residence requirement located in reviewed WHIP terms/FAQ. Foreign-government-official and law-enforcement exclusions are explicit.
statements.locator: Terms Eligibility1(b)–(c); FAQ Q14; entire-page citizenship/residence keyword checks
statements.evidence_limits: Absence in reviewed text does not establish a UK-based person’s eligibility, payment treatment or application to other reward programs.
